name: FindNearestSpanObject
evidence: asks each listed object for up to two spans (func_00141C28) and returns the object whose first usable span has the smallest key at +0x40 (skipping a zero key unless flag bit 1), copying that record to out

name: CollectSpansFromList
evidence: for each object of the list whose flags538 lack the bits 0xC000<<28, gets its spans with func_00141C28 into the output at a 0x70 stride and merges them with MergeOverlappingSpans

name: CollectColliderSpans
evidence: if the object has BSP tree nodes it queries them with func_0013DFD8, else when flags538 has 0x8000<<28 it queries the box at +0x140 with func_00141F48; returns the number of 0x70-byte records written

name: CollectColliderSpansInTree
evidence: the same two-way query as func_00141C28 but takes the tree nodes as an argument instead of reading them from the object

name: TestColliderSegmentHit
evidence: the segment test FindNearestHitObject runs on each candidate: the tree at 0x3A4/0x3F0 with TestTreeSegmentHit when the collider has nodes, else the bounds at 0x140 with the radius at 0x3CC (TestBoundsSegmentHit) when flags538 has 0x8000<<25

name: FindSegmentSphereSpan
evidence: solves the quadratic for the segment a to b against the sphere at p with the radius, and stores the two crossing times, points and outward unit directions in the span (flag 1); returns 0 when the discriminant is below 1e-4

name: CollectBoundsSpans
evidence: queries the bounds at +0x140 for spans, the call CollectColliderSpans and CollectColliderSpansInTree make when an object has no tree nodes; TestBoundsSegmentHit calls it too

name: TestBoundsSegmentHit
evidence: TestColliderSegmentHit's test of the bounds at +0x140 with a radius, through CollectBoundsSpans

name: IntersectSegmentWithCapsule
evidence: original assembly: tests the swept segment p to q against an edge a to b with a radius (closest-approach quadratics, end caps) and fills up to max spans; TestTreeSegmentHit calls it for each edge of a candidate set

name: CompareSpanEndpoints
evidence: qsort comparator on (float time, int tag): -1 or 1 when the times differ by more than 0.0001, otherwise the difference of the tags

name: MergeOverlappingSpans
evidence: splits every 0x70-byte span into a start and an end record, sorts them with func_001F5CD0 and CompareSpanEndpoints and rebuilds the list keeping only the outermost start and end of each overlapping run; returns the new count

name: TestTreeSegmentHit
evidence: TestColliderSegmentHit's test of a collider's tree (0x3F0, 0x3A4) against a segment, through func_0013E430 and func_00142278
